US Politician Addresses Ally's Controversial 9/11 Remarks

Democratic congressional candidate Abdul El-Sayed addressed controversial remarks made by his ally, streamer Hasan Piker, regarding the 9/11 attacks. Piker had reportedly questioned if "America deserved 9/11." El-Sayed, speaking on 'Meet the Press', stated he did not agree with Piker's comments and disavowed them. He also criticized attempts to force him to disavow Piker, attributing them to 'cancel culture,' following his primary election win in Michigan.
